title: Choose Featra's visual world
question: The shell stays familiar (sidebar, projects switcher, provider-grouped chats). This picks the world for the work view. Keep the roll, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Prompt Book
options.lineage: Stage manager's prompt book and cue-light panel
options.thesis: You call the show: agents are crew on cue, every PBI a cue with standby and go.
options.viewport: Feature as a cue sheet: numbered PBI cues down the page, evidence as lit cue lights in the margin.
options.risk: Theatre vocabulary leaks into labels and confuses non-theatre users.

raised.raise: IDs set as catalog numbers: FEAT-1 and PBI-3 are the strongest type on a row.
Counts and dates in tabular figures, aligned in strict columns.
Evidence strength carried by type weight, not only colour.

options.label: Flight Strips
options.lineage: Air traffic control flight progress strips and strip bays
options.thesis: Each PBI is a strip handed between bays; you are the controller who clears it.
options.viewport: Feature rows as strip bays; PBI strips with callsign ID, agent, stage and evidence marks in fixed fields.
options.risk: Fixed strip fields get cramped at 13-inch widths.

options.label: Airport Wayfinding
options.thesis: Status as signage: what needs you reads from across the room.
options.viewport: A 'Waiting on you' sign band above the feature list; arrows route each item to its next step.
options.case: Fuses well for the Inbox and approvals; loses on calm for long sessions.
options.risk: Yellow everywhere turns into alarm fatigue.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft, warm, approachable: the PM view for people who are not engineers.
options.viewport: Feature cards with friendly counts and avatars for each agent.
options.case: Matches the vibecoder audience; loses on density for long sessions.
options.risk: Reads like a to-do app, not a place where code ships.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.viewport: Feature titles set huge, weight tracking progress.
options.case: Fuses poorly: builders scan status, not type.
options.kept: Evidence strength carried by type weight.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.viewport: One feature per plate with captioned PBIs.
options.case: Fuses poorly: too slow for a working tool.

options.label: Factory Catalog
options.thesis: Everything numbered like a catalog release.
options.viewport: FEAT and PBI numbers as the dominant marks.
options.case: Fuses partially: numbering yes, sleeve art no.

options.label: Timetable Rack
options.thesis: The schedule as a rack of slides.
options.viewport: Racked feature slides with time columns.
options.case: Fuses poorly: implies a schedule, and Featra has no forecast.
options.risk: Suggests dates the product refuses to promise.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What ADEs ship (Conductor, T3 Code, Codex app), executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, chat pane, and a tidy list view for the work, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the other ADEs, including the work view.
